summary: Iter 92.63b FINAL RETEST — 6/10 pass, 1 skipped, 3 failed. The FIX PART 2 (public.users mirror in push-to-supabase) is IMPLEMENTED CORRECTLY but STILL FAILS because Supabase public.users table has additional NOT NULL columns beyond {id,email}. Exact error captured from backend log: `Supabase public.users mirror failed: 400 {"code":"23502","details":"Failing row contains (<uuid>, <email>, <email>, null, {}, f, {}, null, ...)","message":"null value in column \"source_platform\" of relation \"users\" violates not-null constraint"}`. Root cause is a SINGLE missing column: `source_platform` is NOT NULL. Existing rows use values like `emergent`. Fix is trivial: add `source_platform: 'leaderos'` (or similar) to the mirror POST payload. The 502→409 change works: Cloudflare now passes the JSON detail through and _write_supabase_insight logs at ERROR level as designed. Autosync-on-login and security-no-leak still pass 100%.

rca_of_the_issue: Iter 92.63b confirms FIX PART 2 (public.users mirror block) executes and hits Supabase, but Supabase rejects it with 23502 NOT NULL on `source_platform`. Backend log line (verified in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log at 2026-07-02 01:03:44): `Supabase public.users mirror failed: 400 {"code":"23502","details":"Failing row contains (e8322cda-9170-4ebe-bcc0-99536d633754, accelerator@wladbot.test, accelerator@wladbot.test, null, {}, f, {}, null, 2026-07-02 01:03:44.523596+00, ...)","message":"null value in column \"source_platform\" of relation \"users\" violates not-null constraint"}`. Because mirror fails, public.users row is never created, and the subsequent leadership_insights insert still raises FK 23503 — the endpoint then correctly returns 409. Fix is a 1-line payload extension, NOT a schema change. Direct probe (`GET {SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/users?limit=1`) confirms existing rows contain `source_platform: "emergent"` and `email_lower` — both should be provided in the mirror INSERT.
